newsitem.title: USA: Tribune shares off on Q4 outlook-analysts.
newsitem.headline: Tribune shares off on Q4 outlook-analysts.

text.p: Tribune Co's stock dropped on Thursday after the company said its fourth-quarter earnings would come in at the low end of Wall Street consensus estimates, analysts said.
Shares of the multimedia company, which said it still expected record full-year results, ended off 5-1/2 at 75-3/4.
Gruntal & Co analyst Rita Zanella said, "Nothing said today (by Tribune) comes as a surprise. This is an overreaction. The market's a little touchy."
The company forecast results at a PaineWebber media conference in New York.
